description: Stalwart's Battlegear Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest. Requirements: - Cenarion Combat Badge x 15 - Cenarion Logistics Badge x 20 - Cenarion Tactical Badge x 17 - Mark of Remulos - Cenarion Circle:
